Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 25a fixup (from Opus review of PR #461). Edit ONLY tools/status.mjs. Logging only: no change to return values, fallbacks, or control flow.

projectStatus is polled (status/watch/board), so the two console.error calls this batch added in tools/status.mjs repeat on every poll:
- the run state.json read catch (~line 30) and
- the spendToday catch (~line 68).
Make both log ONCE per process per distinct (context, error code or message):
- Add a small private module-level helper, e.g. `const loggedOnce = new Set(); function logOnce(context, error) { const key = `${context}:${error?.code ?? error?.message ?? String(error)}`; if (loggedOnce.has(key)) return; loggedOnce.add(key); console.error(`[tools/status.mjs] ${context}:`, sanitizeWorkerText(String(error?.message ?? error), 300)); }`. Do not export it.
- Import sanitizeWorkerText from './worker-text.mjs' (signature: sanitizeWorkerText(value, max)).
- Replace the two console.error calls with logOnce(...), keeping the same silence conditions (ENOENT/SyntaxError for the run state read, ENOENT for spendToday).
The helper must not be able to throw in a way that escapes the catch: wrap its body in try { ... } catch { /* logging must never break status */ }.

Then run: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/status.test.mjs and confirm green. One-line summary.
